## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Aegis Electronic Group, Inc. is a minority-owned small business and franchised stocking distributor
of industrial imaging products and embedded vision technologies. Founded in 1989, we serve OEMs,
system integrators, value-added resellers (VARs), and enterprise end users with industrial cameras,
embedded vision systems, optics, frame grabbers, and imaging components from the industry's leading
manufacturers.

Supporting both analog and advanced digital technologies—including [GigE Vision®][12], [USB3
Vision®][13], [CoaXPress®][14], [Camera Link®][15], [MIPI CSI-2][16], [HD][17]/[4K][18], and
AI-enabled vision—Aegis provides technical expertise from product selection through production.

In addition to distribution, we offer value-added engineering support, camera integration, custom
interface solutions, and modified imaging systems that help customers reduce development time and
accelerate time to market.

We support customers across a broad range of markets, including machine vision, robotics, industrial
automation, industrial inspection, medical devices, life sciences, defense, aerospace, security and
surveillance, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), gimbal and stabilization systems, UAVs and
drones, point-of-view (POV) imaging, pipe inspection, underwater imaging, and other demanding vision
applications.

Aegis Electronic Group, Inc. is a minority-owned small business and franchised stocking distributor
of industrial imaging products and embedded vision technologies. Founded in 1989, we serve OEMs,
system integrators, value-added resellers (VARs), and enterprise end users with industrial cameras,
embedded vision systems, optics, frame grabbers, and imaging components from the industry's leading
manufacturers.

Supporting both analog and advanced digital technologies—including [GigE Vision®][12], [USB3
Vision®][13], [CoaXPress®][14], [Camera Link®][15], [MIPI CSI-2][16], [HD][17]/[4K][18], and
AI-enabled vision—Aegis provides technical expertise from product selection through production.

In addition to distribution, we offer value-added engineering support, camera integration, custom
interface solutions, and modified imaging systems that help customers reduce development time and
accelerate time to market.

We support customers across a broad range of markets, including machine vision, robotics, industrial
automation, industrial inspection, medical devices, life sciences, defense, aerospace, security and
surveillance, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), gimbal and stabilization systems, UAVs and
drones, point-of-view (POV) imaging, pipe inspection, underwater imaging, and other demanding vision

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans

* [Security Cameras][83]
  
  Security cameras, also known as surveillance cameras, are used to monitor homes, businesses, and
  other types of properties. Typically, they are connected to a recording device such as a video
  tape recorder or a disk. In the last few years, IP-based security cameras have become increasingly
  popular. Security cameras enable you to remotely monitor a scene and play back recorded images.
* [Analog CCTV Cameras][84]
  
  Analog Closed-Circuit Television cameras record pictures or videos as analog signals. Most of old
  surveillance cameras are analog cameras. This type of camera records directly onto a video tape
  recorder. In order to save recordings to a PC, the analog signal must be converted to a digital
  format; this can be done with a video capture card.

[Security Camera Basics][82]
* [Security Cameras][83]
  
  Security cameras, also known as surveillance cameras, are used to monitor homes, businesses, and
  other types of properties. Typically, they are connected to a recording device such as a video
  tape recorder or a disk. In the last few years, IP-based security cameras have become increasingly
  popular. Security cameras enable you to remotely monitor a scene and play back recorded images.
* [Analog CCTV Cameras][84]
  
  Analog Closed-Circuit Television cameras record pictures or videos as analog signals. Most of old
  surveillance cameras are analog cameras. This type of camera records directly onto a video tape
  recorder. In order to save recordings to a PC, the analog signal must be converted to a digital
  format; this can be done with a video capture card.
* [Digital CCTV Cameras][85]
  
  Digital CCTV cameras directly capture images and videos as digital signals. The signals are
  compressed and encoded into a standard video format such as MPEG. Digital CCTV cameras usually
  record videos onto a hard drive or a storage server.
* [DVR/NVR Security System][86]
  
  A DVR (Digital Video Recorder) security camera system or a NVR surveillance system is basically a
  series of security cameras connected to a monitor and recording system. Most (old) DVR/NVR
  security camera systems are CCTV-based with the cameras connected to the recording system via
  video cables. A multi-channel DVR/NVR security camera system is dramatically more expensive than a
  regular IP camera; DVR/NVR security camera systems from different vendors require different
  cameras. Using IP-based network cameras, you don't need a DVR/NVR security camera system as each
  network camera can connect to the cloud directly.
* [IP / Network Cameras / Webcams][87]
  
  An Internet Protocol camera or network camera is a type of digital video camera that can send and
  receive data via a computer network. This type of camera has become increasingly popular among
  homeowners and business owners in the last few years because of steep price drop. A webcam can
  also be considered as a network camera because it can send or receive data via a computer.
* [Security Camera Vulnerabilities][88]
  
  Security cameras themselves are not completely secure. They can fail due to dust, smoke, fog, loss
  of power, or damage. They are also easily susceptible to tampering. If a security camera records
  data onsite, both the camera and the recorded data can be destroyed – by intruders, burglars, or
  anyone else who wants the data gone forever.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

## Chief Executive Officer

##### Dr. G. N. Qazi

Dr. G. N. Qazi, CEO, (HIMSR), is a renowned biomedical scientist with over 40 years of research and
academic leadership experience. Holding an M.Sc. in Biochemistry and a Ph.D. in Microbiology, he
previously served as Vice Chancellor of Jamia Hamdard (2008–2016), promoting the integration of
Unani and modern medicine. With over 250 research papers and 60 patents, he is a leading figure in
medicinal plant research and biotechnology. Honored with the 2025 Norman R. Farnsworth Award, Dr.
Qazi continues to drive HIMSR’s mission of excellence in medical education, research, and
healthcare.
[Read More][87]

## Dean

##### Dr. Musharraf Husain

Prof. (Dr.) Musharraf Husain is a distinguished academic leader and accomplished surgeon with over
23 years of experience in clinical practice and teaching. A specialist in laparoscopic and
colorectal surgery, he is dedicated to advancing patient safety, bioethics, and medical education.

480 to 710 beds and leading it to NABH accreditation and the Best Hospital Award 2024. A certified
NABH Assessor and award-winning teacher, Dr. Musharraf is nationally recognized for his leadership
and continues to guide HIMSR toward global excellence.

[][49]

**                     IMPERX TURNS 25**

Celebrating IMPERX’s 25th year as a company dedicated to innovation and the future of industrial
imaging. Established in 2001, the IMPERX team has  strived to offer the highest quality, ruggedized
UV, infrared, and polarizing cameras for industrial applications. This year we are busting through
the ceiling of innovation as we capture never before seen footage of the SLS rocket booster
separation on the Artemis II mission.

[][50]

**IMPERX and ARTEMIS II**

During Artemis II preparations and testing, Imperx cameras are essential for recording precise
visual data under extreme conditions.  By delivering high-resolution imagery under intense
vibration, temperature shifts, and radiation exposure, Imperx technology helps engineers closely
analyze structural dynamics, stage separation, and system performance. This kind of visual data is
essential for mission assurance and contributes to both the scientific understanding and historic
documentation of Artemis II as it advances human spaceflight beyond Earth orbit.

 

 

 

[][51]

**ARTEMIS II SETS NEW RECORD**

The Artemis II crew has made it past the farside of the moon and reached a new record in human
spaceflight at 252,756 miles from Earth. The total lunar eclipse and farside Earth setting view also
gave way to beautiful imagery. The image above, named “Earthset” is notably similar to the iconic
“Earthrise” image taken by Bill Anders on the Apollo 8 mission 58 years ago.

## See The Whole Picture With Imperx Cameras

The Artemis II mission was a success and has officially set a new record for human spaceflight from
Earth at 252,756 miles. The crew managed to gather beautiful imagery of an incredible launch with
the help of Imperx cameras, along with stunning depictions of the far side of the moon and total
solar eclipse on their journey. Imperx cameras were utilized to capture footage of the initial lift
off, as well as close ups of the SLS rocket separation. 

 Visit our Youtube page ([@imperxinc][52]) for the complete, exclusive exterior footage of the
Artemis II rocket taken by Imperx ruggedized space cameras: 

[Imperx Space Cameras in Action][53]

## Proudly Part of Privia Medical Group

IMS Care Center is a proud member of Privia Medical Group. The best doctors in our community have
joined together to form Privia Medical Group (PMG), a multi-specialty, high-performance medical
group that puts patients first. Our physicians are united by the mission of providing better, more
coordinated care for their patients.


To learn more about Privia Medical Group and find other Privia doctors, please visit our
[website][26].

[AdobeStock_286053032.jpeg]

### Your Health, Our Priority

IMS Care Center is Arizona’s largest independent multi-specialty provider group, serving communities
across the Phoenix metro area and beyond. With over 80+ physicians and providers across nine
specialties—including Primary Care, Cardiology, Gastroenterology, Orthopedics, Neurology,
Endocrinology, and Behavioral Health—we offer comprehensive, coordinated care designed to improve
patient outcomes and enhance the healthcare experience.

### Expanding Care for Arizona Families

As IMS care Center continues to grow throughout Arizona, we remain committed to innovation,
excellence, and patient-focused care. By expanding our services, investing in advanced
infrastructure, and developing best practices, we ensure a seamless, high-quality experience for
every patient. Our providers work collaboratively, prioritizing clear communication and continuity
of care. We offer new, comprehensive services to help you stay healthy and safe at every stage of
life. From at-home sleep studies to IV therapy, advanced eye scans, circulation screenings, and
integrated behavioral health—all conveniently available right in our IMS clinics.

Medical Fair India – Delhi 33^{rd} Edition

[Add to Calendar][83] [Application Form][84]

**Medical Fair India** lives up to its more than three-decade-long legacy of bringing together the
best in global and Indian healthcare innovation, collaboration, and industry transformation.

The show has cemented its reputation as the country’s premier platform for the medical and
healthcare industry and continues to uphold its reputation as a world-class platform for industry
engagement, innovation, and empowerment. The 2026 Delhi edition received strong institutional
backing from prominent industry associations and key stakeholders from across the healthcare
ecosystem — from policymakers and innovators to medical device manufacturers, hospitals, tech
startups, and researchers

The 32^{nd} and 33^{rd} editions will take place at Bombay Exhibition Center (Goregaon E), Mumbai
(September 17-19, 2026) and Bharat Mandapam (Pragati Maidan), New Delhi (March 13-15, 2027)
respectively.

#### Show Highlights 2026

15,500 m² Exhibit Area

450 + Delegates

4 Conferences

500 + Exhibiting Brands from 14+ Countries

18,000 + Visitors from 30+ Countries

#### Medical Industry in India

Growth: Indian Healthcare is experiencing a new wave of opportunity

India is the 4^{th} largest Asian medical devices market after Japan, China, and South Korea, and
among the top 20 medical devices markets globally.

The Indian government’s strategic initiatives have been instrumental in propelling the growth of the
country’s medical devices sector. In April 2023, the government approved the National Medical
Devices Policy 2023, with the goal of expanding India’s global market share from 1.5% to 10-12% over
the next 25 years. The policy sets an ambitious target of increasing the market size from USD 11
billion in 2022 to USD 50 billion by 2030, reflecting a robust CAGR of around 15%.

Source: [https://www.ibef.org/industry/medical-devices][85]

## OEM camera | OEM DVRs | OEM converters

skoopia provides video solutions to markets and applications requiring vision assistance. However,
skoopia does not focus on the security industry nor does it focus on the machine vision industry.
skoopia focuses on customers providing integrated video solutions as a product that is sold,
so-called OEM customers (OEM = Original Equipment Manufacturer).  


Medical camera | OEM camera

 skoopia "in Greek: σκοοπία" means "watch". Providing vision aids or "watching" aids in the medical
market is a key target of skoopia. We even named our company after this word.

Intrinsically, every application you can write "scopy" behind, skoopia addresses in the medical
field.

 

Underneath you find applications skoopia provides camera solutions: 
* microscopy camera
* endoscopy camera, triple endoscopy / panendoscopy camera 
* laparoscopy camera, arthorscopy camera, thoracoscopy camera or mediastionscopy camera
* colonoscopy camera, enteroscopy camera or sigmoidoscopy camera
* ERCP camera (duodenoscope-assisted cholangiopancreatoscopy, intraoperative cholangioscopy)
* proctoscopy camera (rectoscopy / anoscopy)
* rhinoscopy camera, bronchoscopy camera, otoscopy camera
* colposcopy camera, hysteroscopy camera, falloposcopy camera
* amnioscopy camera, fetoscopy camera
* cystoscopy camera
* laryngoscopy camera 
* boroscopy camera (formal: non-medical terminology) or esophagogastroduodenoscopy camera


but also in medical fields there are applications not containing "scopy" that require specialty
cameras skoopia can provide, such as: 
* ophthalmology camera 
* dermatology.
* low vision camera, visually impaired camera
* dental camera
* operating theater camera, OR camera
* ICU camera, intensive camera camera 

[[medical camera]][17]
[[medical camer]][18]

skoopia medical cameras excel in very high image quality (predominantly using the lastest Sony
Starvis sensors) as well as specialty outputs without latency (SDI cameras). All skoopia medical
cameras support Full HD as well as CVBS, but skoopia medical cameras are available up to 12 MP. 
* 4K OEM camera is available as 4K SDI camera as well as 4K IP camera.



Vision AI enabled.

 

Our recently added high-performance camera modules offer integration via MIPI (Mobile Industry
Processor Interface), are engineered for seamless connectivity and optimized data throughput —
making them ideal for AI-powered applications such as computer vision, object detection, facial
recognition, and more.

With low-latency data transfer and high-resolution imaging, our MIPI cameras provide the speed and
precision that modern AI workloads demand — whether you're developing smart devices, industrial
automation systems, or edge AI solutions.

Key Benefits:
* Seamless integration with AI chipsets and SoCs
* High-bandwidth, low-power data transmission
* Scalable solutions for edge, embedded, and mobile AI
* Optimized for real-time image processing and analytics

Empower your next-generation AI system with vision that performs


Our MIPI cameras are customer specific, include driver development, and differentiate having image
processing onboard at low power, specifically targetting AI settings in which the AI engine is
focused on intelligent detection and follow up not on image processing. 

Industrial DVR | Medical DVR | OEM converter 

skoopia also provides medical as well as industrial monitors.

 

Whether you require just a regular but robust DVR or converter available for a long period of time
as OEM (because you do not want changes) or need the latest 4K resolution which can be fully
calibrated, skoopia provides longevity and robustness you require for any video output format.


Converters are available to convert any video signal into another for bespoke solutions that require

## INTRODUCTION

Online Counselling and admission to various Post-Graduate (PG) and Under-Graduate (UG) courses in
Medical, Dental and AYUSH at the State level are being conducted by West Bengal Medical Counselling
Committee (WBMCC), formed by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal
under the chairmanship of the Director of Medical Education, GoWB.

## UG Medical and Dental Counselling

Candidates who have qualified through NEET-UG conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) during the
current academic year are eligible to participate in State Online Counselling for Under-Graduate
Medical and Dental Courses for State Quota seats in Government Medical and Dental Colleges with
State Quota, Management Quota and NRI Quota Seats in Private Medical Colleges and State Quota,
Management Quota in Private Dental Colleges in West Bengal. 85% State Quota seats for Under-Graduate
courses (MBBS/BDS) are being allotted through Online Counselling at the State level.

## PG Medical and PG Dental Counselling

Candidates who have qualified through NEET-PG/NEET-MDS conducted by National Board of Examination
(NBE) during the current academic year are eligible to participate in State Online Counselling for
Post-Graduate Medical and Dental Courses for State Quota seats in Government Medical and Dental
Colleges along with State Quota, Management Quota and NRI Quota seats in Private Medical Colleges
and State Quota, Management Quota in Private Dental Colleges in West Bengal. 50% State Quota seats
for Post-Graduate courses in Medical [(MD/MS/PG Diploma), DNB (post-MBBS Degree/Diploma)] and in
Dental (MDS) are being allotted through Online Counselling at the State level. Out of which 40% of
the State Quota degree seats and 50% of the State Quota diploma seats in Medical and 40% degree
seats in Dental are reserved for In-service teachers and medical officers of the Department
(WBMES/WBHS/WBPHAS/WBDES/WBDS). However all the DNB State Quota seats are reserved for In-service
teachers and medical officers of the Department (WBMES/WBHS/WBPHAS).

## UG AYUSH Counselling

Candidates who are interested to participate in the Online Counselling for any Under-Graduate AYUSH
courses (BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS) for State Quota seats in any of the Government AYUSH colleges and
State Quota, Management Quota and All India Quota seats in any of the Private AYUSH colleges in the
State of West Bengal have to qualify in NEET-UG conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) during
the current academic year.85% State Quota seats for Under-Graduate AYUSH courses
(BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS) are being allotted through Online Counselling at the State level.

## PG AYUSH Counselling

AIAPGET, namely ‘All India AYUSH Post-Graduate Entrance Test’, is a single entrance examination
conducted by NTA (National Testing Agency) for admission to Post-Graduate AYUSH Courses for the
current academic year. All the AIAPGET Post-Graduate (Ayurveda / Homeopathy) aspired candidates are
hereby informed that Counselling for West Bengal State Quota seats in State Government AYUSH
institutions will be conducted by West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC) under the
Directorate of Medical Education, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal.

Aegis Electronic Group, Inc. is a minority-owned small business and franchised stocking distributor
of industrial imaging products and embedded vision technologies. Founded in 1989, we serve OEMs,
system integrators, value-added resellers (VARs), and enterprise end users with industrial cameras,
embedded vision systems, optics, frame grabbers, and imaging components from the industry's leading
manufacturers.

Supporting both analog and advanced digital technologies—including [GigE Vision®][12], [USB3
Vision®][13], [CoaXPress®][14], [Camera Link®][15], [MIPI CSI-2][16], [HD][17]/[4K][18], and
AI-enabled vision—Aegis provides technical expertise from product selection through production.

In addition to distribution, we offer value-added engineering support, camera integration, custom
interface solutions, and modified imaging systems that help customers reduce development time and
accelerate time to market.

We support customers across a broad range of markets, including machine vision, robotics, industrial
automation, industrial inspection, medical devices, life sciences, defense, aerospace, security and
surveillance, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), gimbal and stabilization systems, UAVs and
drones, point-of-view (POV) imaging, pipe inspection, underwater imaging, and other demanding vision

## Create Machine Vision Solution with You

Machine Vision technologies present complex challenges to machine builders and system integrators.

With best-in-class know-how, Allied Vision Solutions collaborates with customers to develop
customized, comprehensive vision solutions. By allowing you to focus on your core competencies, we
enable you to direct your attention and resources to other areas of your business.

With over 30 years of experience and strategic partnerships with industry leaders, Allied Vision
Solutions offers extensive vision technology, financial stability, and scalability for any project
size.

Our vertical integration and agile collaboration with customers and internal R&D ensure that we
deliver effective and innovative solutions.

## All pro corporation

All Pro Corporation is founded in 2004 and is the largest exporter of professional healthcare
products in Qingdao, China.

We provide a wide range of medical, health science and laboratory products and services to hundreds
of partners in more than 130 countries, including: Disposable health and medical supplies, medical
equipment, dental products, laboratory supplies, surgeon supplies, medical models, animal care
products, health products (GMP certificates), Chinese herbal medicines, biological extracts,
capsules, biochemical supplies and instruments, etc.

All our sales and manufacturers operate in strict accordance with ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 standards
and requirements. Most of our products are CE and/or FDA certified. We focus on talent, products and
marketing, provide first-class products and services, and are committed to becoming China's top
medical product supplier.

## Welcome to B.J. Government Medical College

Founded in 1946, BJ Government Medical College (BJGMC) is one of India’s premier medical
institutions, renowned for its excellence in medical education, research, and healthcare services.
Affiliated with the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (MUHS) and recognized by the National
Medical Commission (NMC), BJGMC has a rich legacy of producing world-class doctors, surgeons, and
healthcare professionals.
Located in the heart of Pune, BJGMC is closely associated with Sassoon General Hospitals, a leading
multi-specialty teaching hospital providing high-quality, affordable healthcare to thousands of
patients every day.

  Analog Closed-Circuit Television cameras record pictures or videos as analog signals. Most of old

* [Digital CCTV Cameras][85]
  
  Digital CCTV cameras directly capture images and videos as digital signals. The signals are
  compressed and encoded into a standard video format such as MPEG. Digital CCTV cameras usually
  record videos onto a hard drive or a storage server.
* [DVR/NVR Security System][86]
  
  A DVR (Digital Video Recorder) security camera system or a NVR surveillance system is basically a
  series of security cameras connected to a monitor and recording system. Most (old) DVR/NVR
  security camera systems are CCTV-based with the cameras connected to the recording system via
  video cables. A multi-channel DVR/NVR security camera system is dramatically more expensive than a
  regular IP camera; DVR/NVR security camera systems from different vendors require different
  cameras. Using IP-based network cameras, you don't need a DVR/NVR security camera system as each
  network camera can connect to the cloud directly.
* [IP / Network Cameras / Webcams][87]
  
  An Internet Protocol camera or network camera is a type of digital video camera that can send and
  receive data via a computer network. This type of camera has become increasingly popular among
  homeowners and business owners in the last few years because of steep price drop. A webcam can
  also be considered as a network camera because it can send or receive data via a computer.
* [Security Camera Vulnerabilities][88]

  of power, or damage. They are also easily susceptible to tampering. If a security camera records
  data onsite, both the camera and the recorded data can be destroyed – by intruders, burglars, or
  anyone else who wants the data gone forever.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

> “Everything we do, we do with passion – and we do it for life.”

Stefan Dräger, Executive Board Chairman

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

## Chief Executive Officer

##### Dr. G. N. Qazi

Dr. G. N. Qazi, CEO, (HIMSR), is a renowned biomedical scientist with over 40 years of research and
academic leadership experience. Holding an M.Sc. in Biochemistry and a Ph.D. in Microbiology, he
previously served as Vice Chancellor of Jamia Hamdard (2008–2016), promoting the integration of
Unani and modern medicine. With over 250 research papers and 60 patents, he is a leading figure in
medicinal plant research and biotechnology. Honored with the 2025 Norman R. Farnsworth Award, Dr.
Qazi continues to drive HIMSR’s mission of excellence in medical education, research, and
healthcare.

[][49]

**                     IMPERX TURNS 25**

Celebrating IMPERX’s 25th year as a company dedicated to innovation and the future of industrial
imaging. Established in 2001, the IMPERX team has  strived to offer the highest quality, ruggedized
UV, infrared, and polarizing cameras for industrial applications. This year we are busting through
the ceiling of innovation as we capture never before seen footage of the SLS rocket booster
separation on the Artemis II mission.

[][50]

**IMPERX and ARTEMIS II**

During Artemis II preparations and testing, Imperx cameras are essential for recording precise
visual data under extreme conditions.  By delivering high-resolution imagery under intense
vibration, temperature shifts, and radiation exposure, Imperx technology helps engineers closely
analyze structural dynamics, stage separation, and system performance. This kind of visual data is
essential for mission assurance and contributes to both the scientific understanding and historic
documentation of Artemis II as it advances human spaceflight beyond Earth orbit.

 

 

 

[][51]

**ARTEMIS II SETS NEW RECORD**

The Artemis II crew has made it past the farside of the moon and reached a new record in human
spaceflight at 252,756 miles from Earth. The total lunar eclipse and farside Earth setting view also
gave way to beautiful imagery. The image above, named “Earthset” is notably similar to the iconic
“Earthrise” image taken by Bill Anders on the Apollo 8 mission 58 years ago.

## See The Whole Picture With Imperx Cameras

The Artemis II mission was a success and has officially set a new record for human spaceflight from
Earth at 252,756 miles. The crew managed to gather beautiful imagery of an incredible launch with
the help of Imperx cameras, along with stunning depictions of the far side of the moon and total
solar eclipse on their journey. Imperx cameras were utilized to capture footage of the initial lift
off, as well as close ups of the SLS rocket separation. 

 Visit our Youtube page ([@imperxinc][52]) for the complete, exclusive exterior footage of the
Artemis II rocket taken by Imperx ruggedized space cameras:

solar eclipse on their journey. Imperx cameras were utilized to capture footage of the initial lift
off, as well as close ups of the SLS rocket separation.

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## INTRODUCTION

Online Counselling and admission to various Post-Graduate (PG) and Under-Graduate (UG) courses in
Medical, Dental and AYUSH at the State level are being conducted by West Bengal Medical Counselling
Committee (WBMCC), formed by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal
under the chairmanship of the Director of Medical Education, GoWB.

## UG Medical and Dental Counselling

Candidates who have qualified through NEET-UG conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) during the
current academic year are eligible to participate in State Online Counselling for Under-Graduate
Medical and Dental Courses for State Quota seats in Government Medical and Dental Colleges with
State Quota, Management Quota and NRI Quota Seats in Private Medical Colleges and State Quota,
Management Quota in Private Dental Colleges in West Bengal. 85% State Quota seats for Under-Graduate
courses (MBBS/BDS) are being allotted through Online Counselling at the State level.

## PG Medical and PG Dental Counselling

Candidates who have qualified through NEET-PG/NEET-MDS conducted by National Board of Examination
(NBE) during the current academic year are eligible to participate in State Online Counselling for
Post-Graduate Medical and Dental Courses for State Quota seats in Government Medical and Dental
Colleges along with State Quota, Management Quota and NRI Quota seats in Private Medical Colleges
and State Quota, Management Quota in Private Dental Colleges in West Bengal. 50% State Quota seats
for Post-Graduate courses in Medical [(MD/MS/PG Diploma), DNB (post-MBBS Degree/Diploma)] and in
Dental (MDS) are being allotted through Online Counselling at the State level. Out of which 40% of
the State Quota degree seats and 50% of the State Quota diploma seats in Medical and 40% degree
seats in Dental are reserved for In-service teachers and medical officers of the Department
(WBMES/WBHS/WBPHAS/WBDES/WBDS). However all the DNB State Quota seats are reserved for In-service
teachers and medical officers of the Department (WBMES/WBHS/WBPHAS).

## UG AYUSH Counselling

Candidates who are interested to participate in the Online Counselling for any Under-Graduate AYUSH
courses (BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS) for State Quota seats in any of the Government AYUSH colleges and
State Quota, Management Quota and All India Quota seats in any of the Private AYUSH colleges in the
State of West Bengal have to qualify in NEET-UG conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) during
the current academic year.85% State Quota seats for Under-Graduate AYUSH courses
(BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS) are being allotted through Online Counselling at the State level.

## PG AYUSH Counselling

AIAPGET, namely ‘All India AYUSH Post-Graduate Entrance Test’, is a single entrance examination
conducted by NTA (National Testing Agency) for admission to Post-Graduate AYUSH Courses for the
current academic year. All the AIAPGET Post-Graduate (Ayurveda / Homeopathy) aspired candidates are
hereby informed that Counselling for West Bengal State Quota seats in State Government AYUSH
institutions will be conducted by West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC) under the
Directorate of Medical Education, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal.

# The Medical Device
# Integrator + Manufacturer

Your partner and navigator for faster, smarter medical device development.
[
View Capabilities
][4]
With experts in engineering, quality, regulatory affairs, and business development, we have
participated in the development of a wide variety of products spanning interventional radiology,
cardiac surgery, neuro-surgery, gynecological, gastrointestinal, acute care, and general surgery.

## ZIEN brings together every element needed to accelerate your product launch, from development and
## manufacturing to packaging, sterilization, and regulatory compliance.

Our integrated team and infrastructure give startups instant access to the expertise and systems
required to bring a device to market quickly, without the high cost of building their own facilities
or hiring a full team.

ZIEN provides a **Faster, Lower-Cost Path to Market** with up to 70% lower development costs and
12-24 months reduction in time to market. We help you streamline the typical development and
regulatory timeline so you can focus on commercial success.

ZIEN brings together every element needed to accelerate your product launch, from development and
manufacturing to packaging, sterilization, and regulatory compliance.
[
More about ZIEN Medical
][5]

## Rapid Product Launch to a Global Market

Smaller companies often face a disadvantage when seeking regulatory clearance, as developing a
product while maintaining ISO 13485 certification and FDA 21 CFR compliance can be overwhelming. By
acting as the manufacturer of record, ZIEN helps startups and entrepreneurs streamline the product
development and regulatory process, getting products to market faster and worldwide.
ZIEN brings together every element needed to accelerate your product launch, from development and
manufacturing to packaging, sterilization, and regulatory compliance.
[
Global Regulatory Compliance
][6]
